candidates.name: Get-CimInstance
verified_facts: Get-CimInstance retrieves CIM instances for a class or query and returns a snapshot of the instances present on the CIM server
Without ComputerName or CimSession it can query local Windows management data
semantic_limits: The documentation defines inspection semantics but does not prove any current F-host process is alive

candidates.name: Win32_Process class
verified_facts: Win32_Process exposes process identifiers, parent process identifiers, creation time and command-line context
Process identifiers may be reused, so creation time is relevant when validating process identity
semantic_limits: A matching PID alone is insufficient proof of the canonical runner owner

candidates.name: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo
verified_facts: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo retrieves last-run information for a registered scheduled task
Task run information can be recorded separately from process and heartbeat evidence
semantic_limits: Scheduled-task metadata alone does not prove the persistent daemon produced the required output receipts

candidates.name: Start-ScheduledTask
verified_facts: Start-ScheduledTask starts one or more instances of an existing scheduled task
The operation targets a registered task definition rather than inventing a new queue task
semantic_limits: The command must not be used before the single-runner owner and existing-task gates pass

candidates.name: Get-Process
verified_facts: Get-Process retrieves local process objects and supports process-ID based readback
Process information can be combined with CIM command-line and creation-time evidence
semantic_limits: A generic PowerShell process match is not enough; canonical script path and start identity must also match
